description: Makes a private video call link for two (WebRTC, browser to browser, encrypted, no account or app) for your person to open and send on. No audio or video passes through the API. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

locale.description: The language the video call page is shown in: en, de, es, fi, fr, it, nl, pl or pt. Default en. Use the language of the person you are giving the link to.

name: private_video_call
title: Private Video Call
